verdict.rationale: Gusto exposes API endpoints to pull payroll data (GET /v1/companies/{id}/payrolls), payroll.paid webhooks, payroll report generation, and generic 'accounting' app integrations, plus an agent-friendly CLI/MCP server that can fetch payroll/company data for an AI agent to consume. However, there is no explicit documentation of a payroll 'journal entry' export or built-in reconciliation-to-ledger workflow — the evidence shows raw payroll/report retrieval but not a GL-journal-formatted export or reconciliation logic. missing for 10: explicit payroll journal-entry export format, documented reconciliation-to-ledger workflow or accounting-system journal mapping, and independent confirmation an agent has actually performed this reconciliation.
